title: Part 2 Practice: Major Soil Types in Ethiopia

questions.text: Which soil type in Ethiopia is characterized by its deep red color and is ideal for coffee cultivation?
questions.explanation: Correct: Nitisols (red soils) in western/southwestern highlands support coffee cultivation. A is wrong—Vertisols are black soils for teff. C is wrong—Cambisols are brown soils. D is wrong—Solonchaks are saline and infertile.

questions.text: Vertisols are most suitable for growing which Ethiopian staple crop?
questions.explanation: Correct: Vertisols (black soils) in northwestern/central highlands are ideal for teff. A is wrong—coffee grows in Nitisols. C is wrong—sugarcane grows in Fluvisols. D is wrong—cotton grows in Fluvisols with irrigation.

questions.text: Which soil type is found in Ethiopia's river valleys and supports irrigation agriculture?
questions.explanation: Correct: Fluvisols (alluvial soils) are found in river valleys like Awash, Omo, and Blue Nile. A is wrong—Nitisols are in highlands. B is wrong—Vertisols are in highland plains. D is wrong—Cambisols are widely distributed but not specific to valleys.

questions.text: Which Ethiopian soil type is characterized by high shrink-swell capacity and self-cracking when dry?
questions.explanation: Correct: Vertisols have >50% clay causing shrink-swell and cracking. A is wrong—Nitisols are stable. C is wrong—Fluvisols don't crack. D is wrong—Luvisols have moderate clay content.

questions.text: Where are Solonchaks (saline soils) most commonly found in Ethiopia?
options: B) Afar Depression and Rift Valley edges
questions.correct_answer: B) Afar Depression and Rift Valley edges
questions.explanation: Correct: Solonchaks are found in Afar and Rift Valley edges due to high evaporation and salinity. A is wrong—Bale has high rainfall. C is wrong—Simien is cold and wet. D is wrong—Kaffa has humid conditions with Nitisols.

questions.text: Which soil type has the highest cation exchange capacity (CEC) among Ethiopian soils?
questions.explanation: Correct: Vertisols have high CEC (40-60 cmol/kg) due to high clay content. A is wrong—Nitisols have 20-30 cmol/kg. C is wrong—Cambisols have 15-25 cmol/kg. D is wrong—Luvisols have 15-25 cmol/kg.

questions.text: What is the main challenge in cultivating Vertisols in Ethiopia?
options: C) Difficulty in cultivation (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
questions.correct_answer: C) Difficulty in cultivation (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
questions.explanation: Correct: Vertisols are challenging due to high clay content. A is wrong—Vertisols are fertile. B is wrong—Vertisols have low salinity. D is wrong—Vertisols are neutral to slightly alkaline.

questions.text: Which soil type is found on steep slopes and mountainous areas with very limited agricultural potential?
questions.explanation: Correct: Lithosols are shallow, stony soils on steep slopes with limited agricultural potential. B is wrong—Nitisols are deep fertile soils. C is wrong—Vertisols are fertile highland soils. D is wrong—Fluvisols are fertile valley soils.

questions.text: The Awash River Valley's agricultural success is primarily due to which soil type?
questions.explanation: Correct: Awash Valley has Fluvisols (alluvial soils) from river deposits. A is wrong—Vertisols are in highlands. C is wrong—Lithosols are on steep slopes. D is wrong—Xerosols are arid soils.

questions.text: Which Ethiopian soil type requires liming and fertilization to improve agricultural productivity?
questions.explanation: Correct: Acrisols are strongly weathered, acidic, and low in nutrients, requiring liming and fertilization. A is wrong—Vertisols are fertile. C is wrong—Fluvisols are fertile. D is wrong—Cambisols have moderate fertility.
